description.text: A Cosmos holofoil copy given out as the Pokémon League reward of the February 2004 season, the sixth of the 2003-2004 Hoenn cycle (Bulbapedia's set lists call it the e-League). A gold Winner-stamped copy came from the same season.

tell.text: A foil "winner" stamp on the picture: lowercase with a star on Wizards of the Coast cards, "WINNER" beside a Poké Ball on later ones. Cosmos foil whose dots and circles are blocky, as if made of pixels, not smooth.

description.text: A cosmos holofoil copy with a "Winner" stamp in the bottom right corner of the picture, the winners' prize of the Pokémon e-League in February 2004. Everyone who attended got the copy without the stamp.

tell.text: A foil "winner" stamp on the picture: lowercase with a star on Wizards of the Coast cards, "WINNER" beside a Poké Ball on later ones. An oversized copy, several times a playing card's size.

description.text: A jumbo copy of the Winner card, one in each Pokémon League kit of February 2004, the sixth season of the 2003-2004 League year (Bulbapedia's set lists call it the e-League). League kits held a jumbo every month from September 2003 to March 2004, except December.

description.text: A test print of the full-art Mewtwo-EX with no text at all: the art, the type symbol and the empty name and attack bars are printed, but no name, HP, attacks or card number, and the back is blank white. It comes from uncut sheets on which the full-art Mewtwo-EX and Regigigas-EX alternate. Several such sheets had been in collectors' hands for years before some were cut up, so the cards were cut after they left the printer, not at the factory. CGC labels them "Next Destinies Test Print Without Text", and by April 2025 its population report counted 363 of the two together.

starterDeckAudit.regionalPolicy: ST01-ST36 have native English and Japanese inventories; Family Deck is Japanese-only; LD01, SD01 and Super Prerelease products are international-only. Unknown or unretrievable scans are recorded, never invented.
starterDeckAudit.missingScanPolicy: Six LD01 reprints reuse the existing standard image with VERIFY_REPRINT_SCAN; twelve Demo Deck scans are unavailable and omitted. Candidate scans are matched to their official artwork, but not all are confirmed SAMPLE-free.

onepieceIllustratorAudit.policy: Use explicit printing credits and an actual image comparison for the same printed code. Never inherit an author across all variants or infer it from the copyright line. Company/collective credits retain the source name. Cosmetic spacing/case aliases reuse an existing Pokemon artist name; no fuzzy name matching. Conflicts remain unassigned.

onepieceCollectionGroupingAudit.policy: Regional aggregate collections, not equivalent product inventories. Promo membership is the user-requested printed P-code namespace, not proof of a new physical release.

illustratorAttribution.name: SHIE NANAHARA
illustratorAttribution.method: same printed code and matching illustration; explicit source credit

mergedArtwork.verification: EN/JP local scans visually compared; identical Yamato illustration; both match Limitless EB01-007 v1 with the same explicit SHIE NANAHARA credit. Image filenames alone were not used.

onepiecePopupVersionsAudit.reason: A shared artwork record hid individual product editions behind the set chosen in the catalog. Popup entries now identify artwork plus physical product, while favorites and the global card-code family remain stable.
onepiecePopupVersionsAudit.policy: Product editions reuse existing scans of the same illustration; language availability is restricted to explicit regional printSources for that product. Collections such as Promo are not physical editions. DON artwork/finish deduplication remains unchanged.

example.observation: Family Deck and ST02 share the illustration. The separate Family Deck popup edition uses the available Japanese scan; no English Family Deck edition is inferred.

DotGG marketIds are search hints only: several alternate artworks share an ordinary-card marketplace ID. Never merge a printing from that ID without comparing its image. Sources and image comparisons are retained privately.

standardDonMerge.decision: Same monochrome standard illustration. Keep one OP01 popup version and the higher-resolution existing scans; retain product memberships and historical favorite aliases. Super Prerelease stamp, 3D lettering and Gold are visually different and retained.

catalogRefinementsAudit.doublePacks: Only the frontend directory tile is grouped. Individual DP03-DP13 inventories and product identifiers stay unchanged.

2002-2003-next-ten.policy: EN/JA from explicit CardCorpus counterpart links within the same painting group. Regional set inventories stay separate. Foil-only variants and serial-code differences do not create artworks. Distinct edition marks and prize stamps retain individual popup variants. Sources, original scans and conversion cache remain private.

2003-2006-next-twenty.policy: Explicit CardCorpus counterpart links or saved human-reviewed illustrations, names and artist credits. Image similarity only ranks candidates for review and never publishes a match. Native set inventories remain separate. Foil/serial-only variants are collapsed; visible edition marks, stamps and error corrections remain selectable.
